digest.component_or_area: bridge runner and destructive-repair pause ownership
propositions: The bridge must execute identically across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single packaged runner entrypoint without requiring repository-local scripts.

Legacy reconcile workflows using `rebar reconcile --mode` and checked-out environments with historical reconcile vocabularies must retain all existing behavior, defaults, exit codes, and output semantics.
Destructive-repair pause ownership for `fsck --repair` and `doctor --repair` must use a provider-neutral durable git-ref-based gate mechanism with no dependency on GitHub CLI.

The pause coordination system must read existing pause snapshots, call `set_pause`, and clear only the observed OID through `release(..., ref_lock.GATE_REF, ...)` to ensure safe compare-and-swap semantics.

All five environments (local, GitHub, Jenkins, GitLab, bare) and both repair commands must route through the same in-process Python core contract defined in `_bridge_runner.py` and `_repair_pause.py`.
No new lower-trust-actor boundary surfaces or unauthenticated reachability are introduced; the portability layer is pure internal refactoring of existing reconciler and repair logic.
